correctness.rationale: Checked exact labelled counts for odd/even paths and doubled-edge cycles; verified the factorial moment identity and the n-shift coefficient ratio using involution recurrence with explicit elementary bounds. Fixed finite Poisson convergence is moment-determinate. Effective bounded-degree Hanf locality reduces every FO sentence to finitely many bounded small component counts; all remaining radius-r types saturate through infinitely many long path sizes. The converse definability of finite component-count thresholds and harmonic divergence prove exact spectrum and density. A standalone rational checker reproduced 63 identities over 60,398 pairs. Finite checks are not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The object is a canonical labelled random action of the infinite dihedral group (two independent involutions), with natural FO queries such as named colored connected components. Prior work controls cycle structure and words, but those statements alone do not answer the arithmetic form, computability or density of all first-order limiting probabilities. The exact semantic spectrum identifies which local rare events carry all asymptotic logical randomness and which probabilities can occur; this is a natural complete classification and not a chosen small subcase. The result is logically stronger than reporting any one Poisson mean, albeit a synthesis using classical locality.
